_about: Public-domain John Edgar McFadyen (1870-1933), Old Testament professor at Knox College, Toronto, and the United Free Church College, Glasgow, for the Word Hoard: The Messages of the Prophetic and Priestly Historians, The Divine Pursuit, In the Hour of Silence, Old Testament Criticism and the Christian Church, The Messages of the Psalmists, Introduction to the Old Testament, The Prayers of the Bible, Ten Studies in the Psalms, The City with Foundations, The Book of the Prophecies of Isaiah, The Way of Prayer, The Epistles to the Corinthians, A Cry for Justice, The Historical Narrative of the Old Testament, The Psalms in Modern Speech, The Problem of Pain, Isaiah and Jeremiah in Modern Speech, and The Use of the Old Testament. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 104 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
